title: Meeting Bot Consent Firewall
oneLiner: A pre-call control room that blocks risky AI notetakers, collects consent, and creates a defensible share policy for sensitive meetings.
signalRefs: Cyber Unit: AI meeting recorders collect data from people who may not have agreed
Yahoo Finance / Canadian Press: AI meeting tools carry privacy and distribution risks
stitchPrompt: Create a responsive B2B control room called "Meeting Bot Consent Firewall" for teams that need to manage AI notetakers before sensitive calls. The product classifies meeting risk, detects or lists AI bots, shows allowed/blocked recorder behavior, generates consent language, tracks participant opt-outs, sets retention and sharing rules, and produces a client-safe summary preview plus audit log. Required screens/sections: meeting queue, risk score strip, bot policy matrix, consent composer, participant tracker, retention settings, audit trail, and safe-summary preview. Design direction: use the operator-dense profile with crisp compliance-oriented tables, compact controls, subdued risk colors, and a serious enterprise workflow feel.
